subject: embedded wallet destinations
assessment: The embedded BTC and ETH wallet destinations were active before the reported Adform incident
evidence_for: BTC activity from 3 July; ETH activity from 2 July
evidence_against_or_limit: Activity dates do not identify an earlier delivery mechanism or prove shared control of the two destinations

subject: 18 July BTC and ETH activity
assessment: Activity at the two embedded destinations overlapped in time and is consistent with but does not prove one shared episode
evidence_for: Independently reproduced activity windows overlap on 18 July
evidence_against_or_limit: No on-chain path links the embedded BTC seed to the ETH relay route; the decoded route targets a different BTC address

subject: ETH seed and two pre-incident relays
assessment: The relays are strongly linked to the seed and one another
evidence_for: Direct seed funding; one relay funds the other; immediate contract interaction
evidence_against_or_limit: Public chain does not disclose legal or natural-person ownership

subject: seven Harbor and Bridgers calls
assessment: 23.15 ETH 15258 USDT and 33590 USDC were requested to one decoded BTC destination
evidence_for: Decoded verified-contract parameters contain the exact BTC address
evidence_against_or_limit: The destination differs from the embedded BTC seed; requested minimum outputs and BTC payouts are not a one-to-one loss ledger

subject: Harbor and Bridgers
assessment: Observed services are cross-chain routing or swap infrastructure and are not identified mixers
evidence_for: Official product and contract documentation; decoded router calls
evidence_against_or_limit: Later downstream obfuscation or off-chain settlement remains possible

subject: reviewed BTC and ETH paths
assessment: No named mixer Tornado Cash touchpoint or equal-output CoinJoin was identified
evidence_for: Direct path review and transaction structure
evidence_against_or_limit: Applies only to listed public-ledger hops and cannot exclude activity after commingling

subject: incident-window ETH first-hop senders
assessment: Several immediate senders carry public exchange custodian or gaming-service labels
evidence_for: Dated Etherscan and Blockscan public labels plus exact transfer records
evidence_against_or_limit: Labels identify pooled sending infrastructure not the customer payer victim or operator

subject: BTC incident-window sources
assessment: Three incident-window receipts totalling 0.02198465 BTC map to one large unlabeled WalletExplorer cluster
evidence_against_or_limit: Clustering is heuristic and does not identify a provider or customer

subject: all reviewed wallets
assessment: No natural person or named operator can be attributed from the reviewed public evidence
evidence_for: No reliable identity label ENS verified profile or independent campaign report
evidence_against_or_limit: Provider KYC or seized-account evidence would be required

subject: exact embedded BTC wallet
assessment: The preserved Sourcegraph query found no independent earlier code match for the exact embedded BTC address
evidence_against_or_limit: One public code-search query is incomplete and cannot establish absence or cover the ETH wallet payload hashes XOR key C2 or code fragments

subject: recovered TRON replacement string
assessment: No TRON ledger tracing is defensible because the recovered value is invalid
evidence_against_or_limit: A missing character was not guessed

subject: bc1qj0ug web mention
assessment: A generalfinancegroup.com exact-address hit is excluded as attribution evidence
evidence_for: Page repeats transaction-widget rows with unrelated addresses
evidence_against_or_limit: A scraped blockchain display does not establish wallet control
